input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I haven’t been able to send those picture messages—MMS, I think they’re called—for the past few hours. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
It looks like my phone still can’t send MMS messages at the moment. What should I do next?

Oh, that’s quite a list! I get a bit nervous with all these steps—could you please walk me through them one at a time? Maybe we can start with the first one about Airplane Mode? I’m not sure how to check that.
I checked the top of my screen, and I don’t see any airplane icon up there. It shows the signal bars, 5G, and something about data being enabled. Does that mean Airplane Mode is off?

Since I already see something about “data enabled” at the top of my screen, does that mean my mobile data is already on? Or should I still check something else? Sorry, I just want to make sure I’m doing this right.
It looks like my phone is already set to “4G/5G preferred” for the network mode. Is that the right setting for sending MMS? What should we try next?
I just checked, and it looks like there isn’t anything set for the MMSC URL in my APN settings. Is that a problem? I’m not sure what any of that means. What should I do now?

Resetting things always makes me a bit nervous—will I lose any of my photos or messages if I reset the APN settings and reboot the phone? I really don’t want to lose anything important. Could you please reassure me about what will happen?

Alright, I’ve gone ahead and reset the APN settings like you suggested. You mentioned I need to reboot my phone now—just to double-check, restarting won’t erase any of my photos or messages, right? If it’s safe, I’ll go ahead and do it.
I restarted my phone like you said, but I still can’t send picture messages. I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—why isn’t this working yet? Is there something else we can try?
I checked my phone, and it looks like Wi-Fi Calling is already turned off. So I guess that’s not the problem either. What should we try next?
I checked, and my messaging app already has permission for SMS, storage, and phone. So it looks like the permissions are all set correctly. Is there anything else we can try to get MMS working?

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.
